title: At the bike shop
instructions: Bir genç bisikletini tamire getiriyor. Sorunu, süreyi ve fiyatı takip et.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hi. My bike has a flat tyre, and the brakes don't work well.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Let me see. Yes, you need a new tyre and new brakes.

script.speaker: a
script.text: The tyre is quick, about twenty minutes. The brakes take longer. You can collect it tomorrow.

script.speaker: b
script.text: I need it for school tomorrow. Can you just do the tyre today?

script.speaker: a
script.text: OK, but the brakes are dangerous. Please bring it back on Saturday.

script.speaker: b
script.text: I will. How much is the tyre?

questions.prompt: What is wrong with the bike?
options: a flat tyre and bad brakes
questions.feedback: Lastiği patlak ve frenleri iyi çalışmıyor.
questions.evidence: My bike has a flat tyre, and the brakes don't work well.

questions.prompt: Why does Leo want only the tyre fixed today?
options: He needs the bike for school tomorrow.
questions.feedback: Yarın okul için bisiklete ihtiyacı var.
questions.evidence: I need it for school tomorrow.

questions.prompt: When will he bring the bike back for the brakes?
questions.evidence: Please bring it back on Saturday.
